items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: The interviewer mentions Willie Humphrey played in Dewey Jackson's band; the interviewee (Ed Garland) does not claim to have known, met, or worked with Willie Humphrey, only discussing Horace Silver's presence on the boat.

ctx.x: I've known Horace. I think in Chicago.

Mm-hmm. I know he recorded with Charlie Roll Morton up there in Chicago, so I figured he's got to have been around there. Oh, and he played on the riverboat with Willie Humphrey in Dewey Jackson's band, too.
He played here. I was Fountain Blue. He played here on the boat.
